description:
Cast the copy of Vicious Verse by paying {B/R}.
Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist both trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
Biblioplex Tomekeeper's ETB triggers, preparing Stingerquill Voxmancer.
Resolve the copy of Vicious Verse, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat, sacrificing Treasures as necessary to pay for the spell.
